scope: Read-only source and compact existing-summary review; no source-data scan, held-label selection, model fit or new numerical experiment.
proposed_design: Original168/public/physical model plus K16 nearest other same-airport departures within +/-30min, deterministic time/ID ties, per-peer original-clock/physical-witness/missingness/relative-geometry tokens, 32-wide encoder and zero residual, seed42/fixed21/17.

existing_information.present: Airport/runway/stand-zone AOBT clock means, variance, counts, previous/next same-runway scalar clocks; most gaps filtered to 0..10800s.
existing_information.missing: Clock-to-physical-witness pairing for each peer and query-conditioned joint geometry.

existing_information.present: Runway/airport takeoff and landing counts/gaps, mean AOBT taxi proxies, takeoffs since query AOBT.
existing_information.missing: Physical witness and clock on the same individual donor.

existing_information.present: Separate airport physical-age means/counts and deicing share; airport ADSB traffic counts.
existing_information.missing: Donor-level alignment between physical ages, clock ages, geometry and relative takeoff.

existing_information.present: Own stand prior arrival ages/type/airline and dirty-day reporting summaries. Dirty-day inputs absent from ordinary156 but present in Rome classifier.
existing_information.missing: Not a new source of missingness-share information; new branch should not claim that.

existing_information.present: Attention over the query aircraft own temporal track states only.
existing_information.missing: No cross-aircraft context; these failed/inconclusive pooling screens do not test donor-level pairing.

why_new_information_survives: Separate clock and physical marginal summaries are invariant to permuting the physical witnesses among donor clocks. The proposed tokens retain that pairing and its runway/stand/time relationship to the query. Thus they can distinguish coherent same-route queue evidence from stale clocks or badly observed donors with identical existing marginals.
prior_negative_evidence: The retained same-airline prior2h physical-clock median study failed versus airport/static airline references; whole-day medians were nearly redundant. Recent same-airport arrival recorder lags also failed to transfer to departure errors. Therefore broad clock calibration or missing-share reconstruction is not a credible new claim; query-conditioned paired physical context remains untested.
best_applicable_population: Ordinary departures whose own physical evidence is sparse but whose local same-runway/near-stand departures have both genuine AOBT and valid physical witnesses. Also potential witnessed-queue disagreement on well-observed queries. This is a diagnostic population, not a selected inference gate.

cost_context_not_gain_forecast.source_recipe: Saved v77-era remaining_error_cost, not v79 and not a new scoring pass.
cost_context_not_gain_forecast.limits: LTFM may have airport-wide sensor blindness, so its error share is not recoverable capacity without donor coverage. January gross cost is dominated by two previously closed LFPG extreme labels. Rome copied-label errors are largely governed by a separate classifier/rule stack, and Rome ground-observation coverage reverses across years. None implies a14.6s expected gain.

required_source_only_pilot_readouts: Donors with jointly available genuine AOBT and independently gated physical witness, not merely any nearby flight.
Same-runway and nearby-stand physical donor counts; query-own poor/missing physical evidence strata.
K16 truncation frequency and actual maximum donor time distance in dense airports.
2025/2026 January/July sensor-coverage shift; existing physical reliability gates retained.
fairness_and_leakage_contract: Peer selection uses only time/airport/ID and leaves query out even if duplicate raw occurrences exist.
Train references only outer allowed months; held references allowed train plus own held month; no donor departure BLOCK/y/model prediction tokens.
Old/final overlapping IDs retain independent query clocks/identities and namespaces.
Any peer scaling fitted on training inputs only, with saved state.
Original backbone initialization, predictions, gradients and RNG retained by forked initialization; same optimizer/stops/seed.
Peer residual gate is peer presence, not query own-track count; original own-track branch gate remains unchanged; empty peer set gives exactly zero residual.
Scoring uses matched original168/public/physical control through complete unchanged stack, with same-machine comparison; no label-chosen airport/coverage gates.
implementation_risk: Materializing N x16 x~20 float32 tokens can require multiple GB. Retain compact node bank plus neighbor indices and batch gather. Physical ages are censored witnesses, not true off-block labels. K16 time truncation may mostly expose near-simultaneous departures already represented by queue counts.
recommendation: Proceed only to the fixed input-only coverage pilot. The mechanism is new enough for one matched fixed screen if paired witness coverage is broad; current evidence does not establish predictive value or justify a promised high-headroom gain.
